verdict.rationale: Logseq has an opt-in local HTTP API server that exposes the plugin API methods (App, Editor, DB, Git, UI, Assets, FileStorage) through a single bearer-token-authenticated POST /api endpoint. This gives broad programmatic access to the graph, but no document claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do. The API is local-only and community-documented, with no OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, coverage evidence for UI features such as whiteboards, sync, publishing and export, a machine-readable spec, versioning, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: POST `/api` - `method` can be any of the ones listed in https://plugins-doc.logseq.com/.
